exposure: Appropriate for gestational age (AGA) at birth
Small for gestational age (SGA) at birth
Doppler indices (mean uterine artery pulsatility index [mUtA-PI], cerebroplacental ratio, normalized umbilical vein blood flow by EFW)
outcome: Small for gestational age (SGA) at birth
cohort: 1000 singleton pregnancies with normal estimated fetal weight (EFW, >=10th centile) at 32-36 weeks scan.
finding: In normally growing fetuses, a combination of lower maternal sFlt-1/PlGF ratio and lower EFW at 32-36 weeks was predictive of subsequent SGA at birth, while fetal Doppler indices were not.
birth_weight: Birth weight <10th centile for SGA group, and birth weight >=10th centile for control group
